title: Unlocking the molecular mechanisms of bamboo-based remediation of hazardous contaminants: macromolecular interactions, transport pathways, and predictive approaches.
authors: Ali, Muhammad Hayder; Hameed, Muhammad Ashir; Cong, Ma; Malik, Aqsa; Chen, Qibin; Liu, Shiliang
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦竹基大分子与污染物相互作用的分子机制，虽非蛋白质结构核心研究，但提出结合AI结构预测、分子对接和MD模拟的框架，对蛋白结构计算有间接启发。
abstract: Bamboo presents an unusual combination of rapid biomass production and diverse molecular mechanisms for capturing, transforming, and sequestering hazardous contaminants. However, the existing investigations have predominantly focused on bulk removal efficiencies and tissue-level accumulation profiles, whereas the molecular determinants governing these processes remain critically underexplored. This review systematically synthesizes the structure-function relationships of key bamboo-derived macromolecules including cellulose, hemicellulose, lignin, membrane transport proteins such as heavy metal ATPases (HMAs), ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporters, natural resistance-associated macrophage proteins (NRAMPs), and zinc-regulated/iron-regulated transporter-like proteins (ZIPs), as well as oxidative enzymes such as laccases and peroxidases. Specific emphasis is placed on the molecular features that drive contaminant adsorption, transport, sequestration, and degradation. Particular attention is given to surface functional groups, aromatic domains, conserved transporter motifs, and catalytic metal centers. A critical appraisal of the current literature reveals substantial knowledge gaps, particularly in molecular-weight distributions, three-dimensional conformational states, binding affinities, and direct physicochemical interactions between bamboo-derived macromolecules and hazardous pollutants. To address these limitations, we propose an integrative framework combining proteomics, AI-assisted structure prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and quantitative binding assays to uncover the molecular basis of bamboo-pollutant interactions. Future breakthroughs will require the synergistic integration of rigorous structural characterization and direct interaction studies to move from descriptive associations toward predictive structure-function relationships. By consolidating dispersed knowledge and outlining prioritized research agendas, this review furnishes a conceptual framework to advance bamboo-based remediation from descriptive observational studies toward predictive, mechanism-driven strategies for hazardous contaminant management and environmental risk reduction.
abstract_zh: 竹子展现出快速生物量生产与多种分子机制捕获、转化和固定有害污染物的独特组合。然而，现有研究主要集中于整体去除效率和组织水平积累特征，而调控这些过程的分子决定因素仍严重缺乏探索。本综述系统综合了竹子来源关键大分子的结构-功能关系，包括纤维素、半纤维素、木质素、膜转运蛋白如重金属ATP酶（HMAs）、ATP结合盒（ABC）转运蛋白、天然抗性相关巨噬细胞蛋白（NRAMPs）以及锌调控/铁调控转运蛋白样蛋白（ZIPs），以及氧化酶如漆酶和过氧化物酶。特别强调驱动污染物吸附、转运、固定和降解的分子特征，重点关注表面官能团、芳香域、保守转运蛋白基序和催化金属中心。对现有文献的批判性评估揭示了显著的知识空白，特别是在分子量分布、三维构象状态、结合亲和力以及竹子来源大分子与有害污染物之间的直接物理化学相互作用方面。为解决这些局限性，我们提出一个整合框架，结合蛋白质组学、AI辅助结构预测、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和定量结合分析，以揭示竹子-污染物相互作用的分子基础。未来突破需要严格的结构表征和直接相互作用研究的协同整合，以从描述性关联转向预测性结构-功能关系。通过整合分散的知识并概述优先研究议程，本综述提供了一个概念框架，以推动竹子基修复从描述性观察研究向预测性、机制驱动的策略发展，用于有害污染物管理和环境风险降低。
